Lee · Listen & Shadow 22

The Date — meeting up, ordering, talking, the end of the night
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · MEETING UP
💬 Lee
Hey! You're early — have you been waiting long?
벌써 오셨네요 — 오래 기다렸어요?
early — 일찍 온 · wait long — 오래 기다리다
같은 패턴으로 — You're early! · Have you been waiting long?
👤 Her
No, I just got here.
아니요, 방금 왔어요.
just got here — 방금 왔다
💬 Lee
It's freezing out here — let's get inside.
밖이 춥네요 — 들어가요.
freezing — 몹시 추운 · get inside — 안으로 들어가다
같은 패턴으로 — It's freezing — let's get a taxi. · It's hot out here — let's find some shade.
💬 Lee
Do you like Korean food?
한식 좋아해요?
Do you like ~? — ~ 좋아해요?
같은 패턴으로 — Do you like spicy food? · Do you like walking?
💬 Lee
There's a place around the corner — want to try it?
저 모퉁이에 괜찮은 데가 있어요 — 가볼래요?
around the corner — 모퉁이 돌면
같은 패턴으로 — There's a café around the corner. · There's a good spot near the station.
PART 2 · AT THE TABLE
💬 Lee
Have you been here before? I come here a lot.
여기 와본 적 있어요? 저는 자주 와요.
come here a lot — 자주 온다
같은 패턴으로 — Have you been here before? · I come here once a week.
💬 Lee
What do you feel like eating — meat or fish?
뭐 드시고 싶어요 — 고기요, 생선이요?
feel like ~ing — ~하고 싶다
같은 패턴으로 — What do you feel like drinking? · I feel like something warm.
👤 Her
What's good here?
여기 뭐가 맛있어요?
What's good here? — 여기 뭐가 맛있어요?
💬 Lee
The chicken here is really good.
여기 치킨이 진짜 맛있어요.
really good — 진짜 맛있는
같은 패턴으로 — The soup here is really good. · Their coffee is really good.
💬 Lee
It's a lot — should we share?
양이 많네요 — 나눠 먹을까요?
share — 나눠 먹다
같은 패턴으로 — Should we share? · Should we get one more?
PART 3 · TALKING
💬 Lee
So, how was your week?
한 주 어땠어요?
how was your week — 한 주 어땠어요
💬 Lee
I'm a painter — I work with LED displays, mostly for buildings.
저는 화가예요 — LED 화면에 그려요, 주로 건물에요.
display — 화면 · mostly — 주로
같은 패턴으로 — I'm a designer — I work with fabric. · I work with light, mostly at night.
💬 Lee
What do you do on your days off — stay in or go out?
쉬는 날엔 뭐 하세요 — 집에 있어요, 나가요?
days off — 쉬는 날 · stay in — 집에 있다
같은 패턴으로 — What do you do on Sundays? · Do you stay in or go out?
💬 Lee
Sorry, what was that? It's loud in here.
네? 뭐라고요? 여기 시끄럽네요.
what was that — 뭐라고 하셨죠 · loud — 시끄러운
같은 패턴으로 — Sorry, what was that? · Sorry, could you say that again?
💬 Lee
Tell me more about that trip.
그 여행 얘기 더 해주세요.
Tell me more about ~ — ~ 얘기 더 해주세요
같은 패턴으로 — Tell me more about your job. · Tell me more about that.
PART 4 · THE END OF THE NIGHT
💬 Lee
Let me get this — you can get the next one.
제가 낼게요 — 다음엔 사세요.
get this — 계산하다 · the next one — 다음번
같은 패턴으로 — Let me get this. · I'll get the coffee, then.
👤 Her
Are you sure? Next time, then.
정말요? 그럼 다음엔 제가요.
Are you sure? — 정말요?
💬 Lee
I had a really good time tonight.
오늘 정말 즐거웠어요.
have a good time — 즐겁다
같은 패턴으로 — I had a really good time. · I had fun tonight.
💬 Lee
Can I see you again — maybe next weekend?
또 만날 수 있을까요 — 다음 주말쯤?
see you again — 또 만나다
같은 패턴으로 — Can I see you again? · Can I call you this week?
💬 Lee
Text me when you get home, okay?
집에 가면 연락 주세요.
get home — 집에 도착하다
같은 패턴으로 — Text me when you get there. · Let me know when you're home.
느리게 20/20 · 보통 20/20
